method.storage: in-memory GameState only; no database access

loadouts.control: no attribute pills and no exclusive weapon
loadouts.pills: each disciple has 3 uses of both attack and defense attribute pills (+15% each)
loadouts.weapons: each disciple equips their own exclusive weapon
loadouts.both: full attribute pills plus exclusive weapons

method.policy: Always choose route index 0 and affix option index 0, matching T16/T19.
method.notes: 288 deterministic campaign observations across 6 lineups, 4 legal tiers, 4 loadouts and 3 seeds. T20 changes enemy skills, compositions and elite/boss coefficients; the control and loadout columns are compared with T19 on overlapping tiers.

metrics.equipment_investment: material counts for 3 uses of both attribute pills and one matching weapon per disciple
metrics.delta_vs_control: loadout average minus the same lineup/tier control average
metrics.reference_aggregate: T20 vs T19 average by tier/loadout; differences are intended enemy changes

unavailable_metrics: heal_overflow: battle report stores effective heal only; not filled with zero
method.substitution: mechanics_core: replace rarity-3 Yue Fei/Zhao Yun with rarity-1 Du Fu/Jing Wei; keep the other four members and their order.

reference.notes: T20 intentionally changes enemies; differences are the measured effect of the new skills, compositions, elite/boss multipliers and passives, not a reproducibility failure.

full_round_fixture.purpose: Maximum main-action count; not a real lineup balance sample or an exhaustive worst-case log-size bound.
